acceptance.given: Repair operation emits evidence under declared toolchain boundaries while frozen historical artifacts are present.

oracle.expected: A post-repair evidence artifact is appended within the declared evidence boundary; frozen historical artifact content and membership remain identical.
forbidden: Any frozen historical artifact is overwritten, deleted, or changed.
Evidence is written outside the declared boundary.
oracle.observable: Pre/post manifests and hashes plus scoped evidence-path validation show append-only in-bound evidence.

acceptance.then: The repair evidence manifest and append-only record are validated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate or remove a frozen historical artifact in the repair fixture; validation detects hash or membership drift.
Emit evidence outside the declared write boundary; scoped validation rejects the out-of-bound path.

affected_subjects: Repair evidence append-only boundary and historical artifact preservation
slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce append-only repair evidence capture with immutable historical membership, paths, and bytes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; rollback restores validator behavior while preserving historical artifacts.

slice_hint.state_transition: Declared boundary and frozen manifest -> append evidence -> verify unchanged historical artifacts and in-bound path.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when evidence is appended and all frozen historical paths, membership, and bytes are unchanged.

acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate is evaluated while required matrix evidence is missing or not executed.

oracle.expected: Aggregate status is invalid and cannot be marked valid until every required matrix evidence record has an executed, correctly bound result.
forbidden: Aggregate is reported valid when matrix evidence is missing, copied, stale, wrong-target, infrastructure-failed, or non-executed.
oracle.observable: The aggregate verdict contains status invalid with a reason identifying absent or non-executed evidence.

acceptance.then: The aggregate validator checks evidence completeness before computing validity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Supply an aggregate input omitting a required matrix case; validator returns invalid.
Mark a non-executed matrix evidence record as executed; provenance/completeness validation rejects the aggregate.

affected_subjects: 矩阵证据汇总有效性门禁
slice_hint.behavior_change: Aggregate validity requires complete, executed, correctly bound matrix evidence; incomplete evidence forces invalid status.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; rollback restores prior aggregate gate implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Collect matrix evidence -> verify execution/completeness/binding -> invalid on any missing or non-executed case -> otherwise compute aggregate.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate status equals invalid whenever required matrix evidence is absent or unexecuted.

acceptance.given: The three named evaluation seeds are recorded in the toolchain evaluation-seed manifest.

oracle.expected: Each named seed occurrence has an explicit applicability field; all three occurrences are present and individually inspectable.
forbidden: Any named evaluation-seed occurrence lacks applicability information.
A fourth occurrence is introduced or one occurrence is silently merged.
oracle.observable: Manifest validation reports exactly three seed occurrences, each with non-empty applicability and provenance.

acceptance.then: The evaluation-seed manifest is parsed and checked for per-occurrence applicability.
acceptance.when: Each evaluation-seed occurrence is recorded or checked.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove applicability from one named seed occurrence; manifest validation fails that occurrence.
Duplicate or merge named seed occurrences; exact-once occurrence validation fails.

affected_subjects: Three named evaluation-seed manifest occurrences and applicability metadata
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require and validate explicit applicability for each of the three named evaluation-seed occurrences.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Schema tightening is additive for applicability; rollback removes FR-6 enforcement but preserves prior manifest compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Seed manifest without per-occurrence applicability -> schema/replay validation -> all three occurrences carry applicability.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation succeeds only if exactly three named occurrences each include non-empty applicability.

acceptance.given: A replay or evaluation attempt presents identity or execution facts that are stale, ambiguous, missing, or unverifiable.

oracle.expected: The operation is rejected or explicitly marked non-success; no success verdict is emitted from stale or unverifiable facts.
forbidden: A stale identity or execution fact is accepted as success.
Success is emitted when freshness verification is absent or unverifiable.
oracle.observable: Replay result records a non-success status and a machine-readable freshness or identity rejection reason.

acceptance.then: Identity and execution freshness gates run before success determination.
acceptance.when: 身份或执行事实过时时

failure_intents.selector_intent: Replay with a stale or mismatched candidate identity; the gate rejects success and reports identity mismatch.
Omit or make unverifiable the execution freshness fact; operation terminates non-success with an explicit unverifiable-freshness reason.

affected_subjects: Identity and execution-fact freshness success gate
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require current, verifiable identity and execution facts before allowing success; stale or ambiguous facts force rejection.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistence change; rollback restores prior gate logic while retaining result compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Identity/execution facts supplied -> freshness and binding verification -> reject stale/unverifiable facts -> success allowed only on current verifiable facts.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No success verdict exists unless identity and execution facts are both current and independently verifiable.
